turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
International orders ship for a flat rate of $55 and take approximately 5–7 business days to arrive (excluding any delays at customs).
Please note that any taxes, duties, and customs or brokerage fees collected at delivery are the sole responsibility of the recipient. If you need estimates for these fees, we recommend contacting your local customs office prior to placing your order.
